business_problem: Duolingo needed to close important learning gaps in conversation practice and personalized grammar explanation because scripted chats and earlier AI approaches were not flexible or accurate enough for immersive language learning.
solution_summary: Duolingo integrated GPT-4 into a new subscription tier, Duolingo Max, to add richer conversational practice and contextual feedback to its language-learning platform. The company created Role Play, which serves as an AI conversation partner, and Explain my Answer, which breaks down why a learner made a mistake and can continue the explanation through follow-up questions. Learner prompts, lesson context, and mistakes flow into GPT-4, which generates a back-and-forth dialogue or grammar explanation, then returns those responses directly into the course experience so students can continue learning without leaving the app. Duolingo had previously experimented with GPT-3, but GPT-4 provided enough accuracy and flexibility to handle open-ended conversations and more reliable grammar support. That made it possible to move from static scripted exchanges toward a far more adaptive tutoring layer inside the product.

data_flow: Learner responses and lesson context are passed into GPT-4, which returns either a conversational exchange through Role Play or a tailored explanation through Explain my Answer, and those outputs are delivered back into the Duolingo lesson flow for continued practice.
business_outcome: Duolingo launched more immersive language practice, improved the quality of grammar explanations, and sped up internal feature prototyping and engineering work.
